sections.title: Lev
sections.note: "Make this outcome true, and prove it." (your North Star page)

goals.name: 1 · A core where each thing has one owner

end.text: Each capability is one action in one module, and each surface gets it for free. The daemon keeps listed processes alive and does nothing else. A door is a transport. A record has one home.

goals.name: 2 · An agent never loses its way

end.text: One question finds the current truth with its source. A record has a type, one way to create it, and links that hold. A page that shows the system is rebuilt when its input changes.
Each claim has a check that a program or a fresh reader runs. The checks are fast. A green result that lies cannot happen.

chats.title: landmines upstream pull request: what we did, and what upstream asks

end.text: One app shows what each agent does toward which goal, and asks you only what is yours. An agent answers the rest as you would.

goals.name: 5 · Lev is out, and people know why

end.text: Release 0.0.1 is public, with your essays and the launch videos beside it.

sections.title: The products
sections.note: order from your words: Survival and Suntiq launch first, the legal product after

end.text: "A team chat where people and their coding agents work together". Each agent runs on its owner's Mac, the owner decides, agents work with each other in the room, and a call is part of the room. Nobody forwards agent output by hand.
Boat clubs, rental fleets, owners, road fleets and service shops "see their assets live, book and hand them over, and keep them serviced", with Sophie as the assistant in the apps.
Live in production with a free and a paid plan, and a privacy notice that is true.

laws.name: One owner.
laws.text: Each thing lives in the module that owns it. Each way in or out is a port with an adapter behind it.

laws.name: An action, not a command.
laws.text: A capability is one action, and each surface gets it.

laws.name: Name it by what it is.
laws.text: One thing has one name and one shape.

laws.name: Code that exists is evidence of an intent.
laws.text: It is never the pattern to copy.

laws.name: Done means a check ran.
laws.text: A program for what is exact, a fresh reader for judgment.

example.title: The daemon chat, as the example

today.title: Its goal today
today.text: "Finish the daemon." So each missing thing becomes a daemon job, and the door code that is already in its folder becomes the pattern. It breaks laws 1 and 4.

should.title: The goal it should have
should.text: "Lev's background parts stay alive, and each part lives where it belongs." The daemon reads a list and starts, restarts and stops what is on it. A door goes to its transport. Who may call goes to one shared security part. The first question for each line of code is "who owns this?"
